record_scope_reconstruction: The local 7 April 2023 report identifies a three-hour protest with tractors extending over three kilometres at Siret customs. Reuters describes the wider national protest but does not itself name Siret in the inspected text.

source_checks.finding: Local full text names Siret customs, Friday noon and traffic blocked for three hours over a three-kilometre approach.
Reuters full text establishes nationwide farmer protests but lacks a Siret-specific sentence; not used alone for site identity.

sites.name: Siret–Porubne
sites.coordinate_method: Independent inspection of preserved versioned OSM source metadata; no fresh OSM API retrieval claimed

sites.evidence_note: Preserved OSM node 3019220234 v3 anchors the Romanian road-control end; the Council land-border evaluation identifies Siret opposite Porubne on E85. The independent published crossing coordinates at umanmap.eu are within about 70 m. Actual protest machinery stretched along the approach, not necessarily at this pin.
